technical.summary: IBM shows extreme oversold conditions with longer-term bullish structure, but price action remains deeply bearish below all key moving averages with negative momentum and downside breakouts—high risk of further decline before any reversal.

fundamental.summary: IBM shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 55 days present material risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (22/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction (one small purchase 51 days ago vs. two sales) and absent news sentiment limit conviction.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (395.2) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 55 days adds moderate event risk; macro score of -1 confirms unfavourable conditions.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold RSI conditions (contrarian buy signal) combined with longer-term bullish EMA/SMA structure and fear-zone sentiment (22/100) create a classic reversal setup for patient swing traders.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains deeply underwater below all major moving averages with negative MACD, downside Donchian breakouts, weak volume (0.77 ratio), zero institutional conviction, and VIX crisis regime (395.2) creating structural headwinds that oversold technicals cannot overcome.
